boundary: Real HTTP over PHP built-in single-worker, WP7.1.4/Woo11.3/MariaDB/HPOS. TwentyTwentyOne theme, isolated exin_release_ DB prefix, SAVEQUERIES instrumentation; 1 discarded warmup and 5 measured repeated requests per route/variant. This does not flush the database/OS caches; PHP/WordPress request-local caches start fresh on every request, and no persistent object cache or PHP opcache is enabled. Both empty and populated anonymous-cart contexts are measured; financial validation remains fresh. Dedicated fixture heartbeat is refreshed before each variant to measure healthy requests. No Production or traffic-capacity benchmark. No Redis server/client/extension/drop-in installed; Redis-enabled/failure tests unavailable.
measurement_boundary: Server SQL/CPU/time/peak metrics recorded on WordPress shutdown at PHP_INT_MAX, after ordinary WordPress/WooCommerce/Action Scheduler shutdown callbacks. Client latency spans the complete HTTP response. Later raw PHP shutdown callbacks, if any, are outside this server hook boundary.
